nodes.text:
An HMPV thread:

That HMPV, or "Human Metapneumovirus", can cause symptoms that resemble the common cold, has been known for more than 2 decades.

An HMPV infection typically results in a cough, fever, a blocked nose and some shortness of breath (1/6)

nodes.author: KamathGurudutt
nodes.text:
Awesome thread on HMPV.

(Dear Doctors/friends -- please share posts about HMPV in a sane manner like below. Even by mistake do not spread panic - by reposting misleading posts. Do avoid jokes too please.)

Summary: there is no need to panic about HMPV. https://t.co/1vV5dWERyA

nodes.author: MenonBioPhysics
nodes.text:
A small fraction, between 5% and 10%, of all respiratory infections during the flu season everywhere, are caused by this virus.

The symptoms are usually mild, but the very young and the very old may be more susceptible to severe disease.
(2/6)

nodes.author: MenonBioPhysics
nodes.text:
The cold season is a time for respiratory infections to spread. 

One should deal with this one as you deal with flu, by protecting elderly people, washing hands regularly, and by wearing masks if you are coughing, so as to reduce the chance of infecting others. (3/6)

nodes.author: MenonBioPhysics
nodes.text: The reported rise in cases in China are nothing to worry about. A rise in viral respiratory illness is common in this season and happens everywhere. (4/6)

nodes.author: MenonBioPhysics
nodes.text: It is important to understand that HMPV is nothing like COVID-19, since we have all likely been exposed to it before, unlike the case for COVID-19 which was a novel virus. (5/6)

nodes.author: LovingVaccines
nodes.text: An important thread from @MenonBioPhysics on HMPV. https://t.co/qPOECUZSJx

nodes.author: MenonBioPhysics
nodes.text:
Just take the normal measures which we would to avoid getting the flu and to protect others, especially the elderly, from getting it. 

There is no need to worry specifically about HMPV. (6/6)

nodes.text: @MenonBioPhysics Why then is this being fanned and drummed up in our media!!!! Opportunistic propaganda on a Covid rattled population??? If so, Why? Mass Distraction???

nodes.text: @TarunSouradeep Makes no sense to me, either, apart from the fact that the magic word "China" seems sufficient for people to take leave of common sense.
